claude_proposed_widenings.name: upgrade_save_damage_outcome
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Evasion remaps the two damage tiers of a Dex-save-for-half effect: success goes from half → no damage; failure goes from full → half damage. No existing atom covers this save-outcome-tier remap. grant_resistance halves unconditionally (wrong tier logic). modify_roll_advantage changes the roll itself. reduce_damage_taken is a fixed subtraction independent of save outcome. The semantic here is 'for qualifying save-gated damage effects, shift both outcome tiers down by one level' — a distinct effect not representable from existing atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and only half damage if you fail.

discrepancies: no content/rogue_evasion_l7.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
